adjudication.inconclusive_rule: At least one registered comparison is scoreable but neither prior rule is met.
adjudication.promote_rule: The base-cost training-selected addition must have at least the minimum paired origins and a strictly positive lower 95 percent origin-bootstrap gain bound for both variance and ES90. Promotion is only a research-feature disposition.
adjudication.retain_research_rule: Both base-cost training-selected point gains are positive but the registered promotion rule is not met.
adjudication.stop_missing_evidence_rule: No registered comparison reaches the minimum paired-origin support.
